title: Session: Unverified visitor application forms
objective: Validate version 2.12.1 guest forms and officer approval for unverified visitors, while retaining automatic verified Guest/FC Member access and the established lobby policy.
user: After this release is checked and published, deploy 2.12.1 with a stopped-writer backup, migration 004, and updated command registration.
Run `/config guest_applications channel:#officer-chat`, then `/config validate`. Existing reviews stay in their original room.
As an unverified visitor, use `/apply` in the lobby. Check both questions, no early Guest grant, and the same application on repeat.
As an officer, inspect answers and Approve. Check Guest delivery, ordinary channels, lobby removal, the DM, and `/guest status`.
With another visitor, test Deny/cooldown, stale forms after rejoin, original buttons after restart, deleted-review repair, and visitor approval denial.
Check verified non-FC auto-Guest, FC Member precedence, and revocation using non-owner/non-Administrator accounts.
assistant: Check immediate modal acknowledgement, fresh submission authorization, durable answers, duplicate/stale/cross-user rejection, and officer message binding.
Run source quality and supplied/synthetic PostgreSQL suites, validate the synchronized App Platform spec, and inspect PR checks and matching image publication.
Record live application IDs and outcomes, review-channel selection, pending delivery/recovery work, and preservation of ownership, ledger, and existing access.
bot: Run compiled version 2.12.1 with Drizzle and require the migration 004 checksum before accepting work.
Persist form answers, audit, and review work atomically; show answers only in the configured review room and require a current officer decision before manual Guest access.
Preserve current join binding, cooldown, revocation, registered-visitor policy, channel exclusions, and restart-safe review/role delivery; expose pending or blocked work through status commands.
Post this responsibility-separated session plan in the configured development channel.
